invoices.title: Customer invoices
invoices.lead: Customer invoices: drafts, issued, cancelled and reversals. An invoice gets its number when it is issued.
invoices.createDenied: You are not allowed to create invoices

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.description: Create an invoice for a client or issue it from an order: lines, discounts and totals, then issue it.

submit.description: Only drafts are issued: each gets a number and can no longer be changed. Invoices in other statuses or in a closed period stay as they are; the report lists them with the reason.
submit.denied: You are not allowed to issue invoices
submit.notAllowed: Only a draft can be issued

cancel.description: The invoices become void but stay in the list. One reason for all, shown in the history of each. Drafts are deleted, not cancelled; an invoice in a closed period is reversed.
cancel.denied: You are not allowed to cancel invoices
cancel.notAllowed: Only an issued invoice can be cancelled: a draft is deleted, a cancelled one is already cancelled

delete.description: Only drafts without a number are deleted for good. An issued invoice is cancelled or reversed, not deleted: such invoices stay; the report lists them with the reason.

invoice.title: Invoice

submit.title: Issue the invoice?
submit.description: The invoice gets a number and can no longer be changed. Mistakes are fixed by cancelling and a new copy, or by a reversal.

exchange.noRate: No {{currency}} rate on or before {{date}} in the exchange rates
exchange.rateDraft: {{rate}}, fixed when the invoice is issued

invoice.periodLockHint: A mistake in an invoice of a closed period is fixed by a reversal dated today.

payment.denied: You are not allowed to record payments

refund.denied: You are not allowed to refund clients

paymentLink.title: Payment for invoice {{number}}
paymentLink.description: Scan the QR code in a banking app or copy the link and send it to the client: the bank opens a transfer with the payee, amount and purpose filled in.
paymentLink.settled: The invoice no longer awaits payment: nothing to pay.
paymentLink.missing: No link or QR code: {{reason}}. The invoice keeps the details from the time it was created: fix the company profile, and new invoices take the right ones.

invoice.editDenied: You are not allowed to change invoices

locked.submitted: An issued invoice is not changed: cancel it and make a corrected copy, or reverse it
locked.cancelled: A cancelled invoice is not changed: make a corrected copy
locked.linked: Credit notes are issued against this invoice: cancel or reverse them first
locked.credited: The invoice is already fully covered by credit notes
locked.has_payments: The invoice has a payment or refund: cancel or reverse them first

delete.denied: You are not allowed to delete invoices
delete.title: Delete the draft?
delete.description: The draft is deleted for good together with its lines. It has no number yet, so numbering does not change.
delete.descriptionAmended: The draft is deleted for good together with its lines. The cancelled invoice it was made from can be corrected again.
delete.descriptionOrder: The draft is deleted for good together with its lines. The order it was issued from can be invoiced again.

locked.submitted: An issued invoice is not deleted: cancel or reverse it
locked.cancelled: A cancelled invoice is not deleted: it stays in the history

parties.invalid: Could not show the party details

qr.missing: The payment QR code is not printed on the sheet: {{reason}}. Invoice details are a snapshot taken at creation: fix the company profile, and new invoices will pick up the correct ones.
qr.foreignCurrency: An invoice in {{currency}} is printed without a QR code: the NBU QR code is for hryvnia only. Enter the currency account details in this invoice's supplier block.

issues.currency: the NBU QR code exists only for invoices in hryvnia
issues.iban: the supplier details have no valid IBAN
issues.code: the supplier details have no valid EDRPOU or RNOKPP code
issues.name: the supplier name is empty, longer than 140 characters or has a line break or invisible characters
issues.purpose: the payment purpose is too long or has a line break or invisible characters
issues.amount: the amount due is outside the transfer limits

invoice.linesInvalid: Could not show the invoice lines

invoiceForm.copyOf: Copy of «{{title}}». The new invoice appears after «Save».
invoiceForm.dueDateBefore: Not earlier than the invoice date
invoiceForm.currencyHint: The {{base}} amount uses the rate on the invoice date; issuing the invoice fixes the rate.
invoiceForm.currenciesFailed: Could not load the company's currencies: only the base currency is available.

parties.fillCompany: Fill in from the company profile
parties.companyLoading: The company profile is still loading
parties.fillClient: Fill in from the client card
parties.clientFirst: Choose the client first: the details come from their card

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.lead: Customer credit notes against issued invoices: the client returned goods or the amount went down. A credit note gets its number when it is issued.

empty.title: No credit notes yet
empty.description: Create a credit note on the card of an issued invoice: “Create credit note”, then keep the returned lines and quantities.

creditNote.title: Credit note

submit.title: Issue the credit note?
submit.description: The credit note gets a number and can no longer be changed. A mistake is fixed by cancelling it with a new copy or by a reversal.

creditNote.periodLockHint: A mistake in a credit note of a closed period is fixed by a reversal: it is dated today.

locked.submitted: An issued credit note cannot be changed: cancel it and make a corrected copy, or reverse it
locked.cancelled: A cancelled credit note cannot be changed: make a corrected copy
locked.exceeds_invoice: Other credit notes have already returned some of these lines: lower the quantity in the draft
locked.invoice_inactive: The invoice is cancelled or reversed: the credit note cannot be issued

delete.title: Delete the draft?
delete.description: The draft will be deleted for good with its lines. It has no number yet, so numbering stays the same.
delete.descriptionAmended: The draft will be deleted for good with its lines. The cancelled credit note it was made from can be corrected again.

locked.submitted: An issued credit note is not deleted: cancel or reverse it
locked.cancelled: A cancelled credit note is not deleted: it stays in the history

creditNote.linesInvalid: Could not show the credit note lines

lines.label: Returned lines
lines.hint: Keep the lines being returned and set the quantity. Price, discount and tax come from the invoice.
lines.name: Name
lines.exceedsInvoice: That much is no longer left in the invoice: other credit notes returned part of it
